mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, we have clear skies and a temperature of 62 degrees at Fireman's Park. Please be aware of an elevated air quality index of 61. You can spot the ISS passing overhead tomorrow morning at 5:47 AM, rising over Cross Plains and heading toward Madison. Overnight, we expect a low of 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Plan Commission is meeting on November 4th to discuss several developments, including the Ardent Glen third addition and new site plans on Milky Way. Additionally, the Finance Department reminds residents that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by ART House 360 and Hop Haus trivia tonight. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
On Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers confirmed that alcohol was not a factor, and no students were injured during the incident.
Enjoy the Dark Chocolate PB Crunch flavor of the day while the store is open until 10 PM tonight.
